free_text_notes.physician_note: 54-year-old man with atrial fibrillation, prior TIA, admitted 3/21 with left MCA ischemic stroke with mild right hemiparesis. MRI confirmed small infarct; no hemorrhagic conversion. 3/24 10:00: New right arm drift at 13:00 (NIHSS up from 2 to 5); repeat imaging ordered. The patient was treated for shingles approximately two years ago. The condition fully resolved and no residual effects were noted during this admission.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty. Bedroom is upstairs at home; setup not reviewed yet.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and son to review the discharge plan. Patient has questions about what to eat at home. Son normally works days but has taken the afternoon off to drive the patient home at the planned time.
